dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *humming*... Oh hey!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Beautiful weather, fresh air, a stellar view... And to top it all off, some fantastic company! I couldn't ask for a better day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, well, that's an easy one...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I love camping in all sorts of places — I'm not picky. Whenever I'm on the road delivering fruit, I'll park the cart and pitch a tent just about anywhere. It's comfortable enough for me!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I guess the only time I ever feel uncomfortable is during the team stage of the Pilgrimage. The looks from the other contestants are just too intense...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I guess, but this place is different!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I feel so... at ease. It's hard to find this feeling anywhere else.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It's like... everything was arranged just for me — from the amenities, the landscaping, down to the tiniest details! I feel so at home! It's amazing!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I mean, sometimes, I have to be on guard even in my own place. Like when my mom rearranges the furniture, and I go to sit in my usual chair without thinking, just to land on the ground instead...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thankfully, I've got some extra padding on me, so it didn't hurt, hehe.

choices.text: Well, you'd be right, because I did arrange this place just for you!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: R—Really? Oh, wow. I... I...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I can't believe a great hero did all this just for me! That's an honor even famous people never experience. It's like a real life power-up!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Okay, I'm pumped! Gotta train even harder now!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: C'mon, gimme a fist bump, hero!

choices.text: Guess we have a similar style, then!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: R—Really? Oh, wow. I... I...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #I can't believe I have the same taste as {NICKNAME}. You've been to so many nations, and you're friends with so many heroes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Sure! Let's chat the day away. I have nothing else to do...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, but chit-chat is always better with a few snacks a drinks... A full course meal works too, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Here's an idea... Let's start a bonfire. We can set up a pot and make something while we talk!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, it's just a hobby! Honestly, I'm not very good, hehe... It takes me a while to get the hang of new recipes.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Like, when I first tried making Puff Pops. I kind of... blew up the kitchen. The pan flew so far, it hit Master Iansan in the head...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: ...*sigh* That pan has never been the same since.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Now, I'm not allowed to cook in the house. So, I'm stuck with whatever I can make outside with a campfire.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It usually doesn't turn out great, but making something myself always brings a certain sense of accomplishment, and that's something you can't get from a restaurant.

choices.text: I agree! There's something special about homemade dishes.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Next time, let's make something together! You can bring the veggies and condiments, and I'll be in charge of fruit and protein! We'll come up with something amazing!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #And then, we can name it after ourselves! Something like... "{NICKNAME} and Varesa's Glorious Grilled Meat Fortress"!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Although, that name gives us a lot to live up to... We'd need to add a lot of intense flavor and roast the meat on super high heat...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Which also means... We should find somewhere with less... safety hazards, considering my history with cooking accidents.

choices.text: It's alright. Bring on the explosions!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, cool! Bring it on!

choices.text: I've had my fair share of kitchen mishaps, too.
You must be quite the chef!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Actually, there's something I've been thinking about for a long time... And, now that it's just the two of us, I...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I... think I'm gonna come right out and say it...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Can we... spar? Like, I want you to go all-out, hold nothing back!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You're a hero, a legend, and the strongest person I know... I really look up to you! You give me something to aspire to!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So, I want to see... Just how much separates the two of us at our full strength!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I guess it's a little confusing... I mean, you could probably go to toe-to-toe with an Archon, but I'm still scared of hurting you. My fighting style is a bit, um, all over the place...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I just mean, um... *sigh* What am I even trying to say...

choices.text: Even if it's just a spar, I don't think I can go all out against you.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, no... I get it. I should have thought about it that way...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I can get behind that answer. Somehow, it makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Wait... Why don't we test our strength a different way? Like... through some exercise?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Alright, then we'll warm up with a ninety-thousand-step sprint and then swim half that distance. Once that's done, I'll bring out the weights. Fifty should do it... Each one is around the weight of an adult tatankasaur.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ooh, I'm getting excited! I can't wait to see you bench! I bet you look so cool!

choices.text: I'm lucky adventuring helps keep me in shape.
Because, like you, I don’t like fighting my friends.
You want me to go all out?
You're being super serious all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Varesa.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Morning! Y'know, somehow, you make me feel ready to take on the day! For once, I don't feel like going back to sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Varesa.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Night! With your kind wishes, I'm sure I'll sleep like a baby tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Whoa! This feels so familiar... It's exactly like the Collective of Plenty! Even the training equipment is identical!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It's fun to travel and see new things, but eventually endless novelty can get tiring in its own way.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Now that I've found this second home, and you're here with me, I feel like all my worries have vanished.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: A soft bed, fluffy pillows, cool, smooth blankets and sheets... It's enough to make you never want to leave again...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Wait, no, I can't fall asleep just yet... First, I need to eat my favorite dessert until I'm just over half-full, then get my hands and feet all toasty and warm by the furnace, and finish off with half a glass of water...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If I do all of that, I'm sure my dreams will be as sweet as the fruit from my orchard, hehe...
